keyVerseDR: "For my flesh is meat indeed: and my blood is drink indeed." (Jn 6:56 DR)

level1.title: Jesus Gives Himself
level1.story: Jesus said, "My Flesh is true food, and My Blood is true drink." In Holy Communion, we receive Jesus. He stays in us, and we stay in Him.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say is true food?
How can you get ready for Communion?
level1.prayer: Jesus, come into my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus in the tabernacle
activity.intro: Draw the tabernacle in your church, where Jesus is truly present.
activity.prompt: Inside my church: the golden tabernacle with the red sanctuary lamp burning beside it

level2.title: True Food and True Drink
level2.story: Jesus said, "The bread that I will give, is My flesh, for the life of the world." The people argued, "How can this man give us His flesh to eat?" Jesus said, "Except you eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink His blood, you shall not have life in you." He said, "For My flesh is meat indeed: and My blood is drink indeed." Whoever eats His flesh and drinks His blood abides in Him, and He in them.
level2.keyLine: My flesh is meat indeed: and my blood is drink indeed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why do Catholics believe the Eucharist is truly Jesus?
What does it mean to 'remain' in Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, truly present, I adore You. Amen.

activity.title: Adoration
activity.intro: Jesus is truly present. Write a prayer before the tabernacle.
starters: Jesus, I believe You are here...
